events.text: In 2023, HomePro expanded renewable energy use with 90 solar roof projects, and its 'Trade In' campaign managed over 122,000 old items for a circular economy.
In 2022, HomePro achieved a 46.9% sales mix of ECO products, a 39% reduction in energy consumption from the 2014 base year, and solar rooftops at 65 locations.

HomePro's GHG Emission Reduction Plan targets lowering electricity consumption per area by 40% from base year by 2025, zero waste to landfill by 2030, and 100% renewable energy in Company-owned stores by 2030.
Home Product Center's 2024 Sustainability Report reports group greenhouse gas emissions of 221,723 tCO2e and sets a net-zero target for 2050 covering the Company and its subsidiaries.

Home Product Center's GHG Emission Reduction Plan targets lowering electricity consumption per area from base year by 40% by 2025, zero waste to landfill by 2030, and producing or using 100% renewable energy in stores with buildings owned by the Company by 2030.
In its 2023 Sustainability Report, HomePro committed to achieving Net Zero greenhouse gas emissions by 2050.
In 2023, HomePro expanded its renewable energy use with 90 solar roof projects.
In 2023, HomePro introduced the 'Trade In' campaign to promote a circular economy, managing over 122,000 old items.
Home Product Center's GHG Emission Reduction Plan targets zero waste to landfill by 2030.
Home Product Center's GHG Emission Reduction Plan targets producing or using 100% renewable energy in stores with buildings owned by the Company by 2030.
Home Product Center's 2023 Sustainability Report states 2023 solar electricity production of 73,642,243 kWh.
Home Product Center's 2023 Sustainability Report states revised 2023 water consumption of 210,017 m3.
